name: Checkly
summary: Checkly combines uptime monitors with API and Playwright browser checks. Its free Hobby plan has 10 uptime monitors and capped check runs, Starter costs $24 a month on annual billing, and Team at $64 adds every location, phone alerts and 30-second checks.

evidence.capability: http and ping checks from many locations

facts.text: ICMP ping monitors became available on all Checkly plans on March 2, 2026.
On Hobby and Starter, a check can run from up to 3 of 6 locations.
Checkly says it does not cover domain expiration, UDP or mail protocols.
Raw results are kept for 7 days on Hobby and Starter and 30 days on Team, and aggregated results for 30 days and 1 year.
Checkly stores data in the EU, in AWS eu-west-1 in Ireland.

plans.name: Hobby
plans.notes: 10 uptime monitors at 2-minute intervals; 10,000 API and 1,000 browser runs a month, hard-capped

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Billed annually; $29 on monthly billing. 50 uptime monitors at 1-minute intervals, 3 seats, 100 SMS alerts

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Billed annually; $80 on monthly billing. 75 uptime monitors at 30-second intervals, 10 seats, 200 SMS and 200 phone alerts

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Price on request. Adds SAML single sign-on

hiddenCosts: Status pages with a custom domain need the Communicate add-on, $9 a month on Starter or $30 on Team with annual billing.
Extra uptime monitors cost $8 per 25 a month on annual billing.
Browser check overages cost $6.50 per 1,000 runs on Starter and $6.25 on Team.

contract.cancellation: Fees are non-refundable and paid in advance, and downgrades take effect at the end of the billing cycle.
contract.dataExport: Report tables as CSV, plus a Reporting API.
